head: 09abf3753bdfc9753a45004048b95a17afb311f4
blockers: READ_FAILURE_UNSAVABLE_GAMEPLAY: src/ToyWarsServer.server.lua:90-95 returns (nil,false) on GetAsync exception or unknown schema; join:621-659 treats absent loadFailure as success and creates active default Coins=50 with persistAllowed=false. tests/auto/progression_rejoin_spec.lua explicitly asserts 'read failure allows play' and 'unrecognized version' starts default gameplay. Reproduce stored coins=500, GetAsync throws once, player joins and earns 300, leaves; no final save, all new progress silently lost. Require fail-closed join (no normal gameplay, free plot and visible retry) for failed reads/unknown schemas/unavailable store, with whole-server negative control; update only the now-invalid fallback expectations to stricter tests, preserving no-overwrite behavior.

FINAL_SAVE_TRANSIENT_FAILURE_NO_RETRY: src/ToyWarsServer.server.lua:151-179 and PlayerRemoving:689-705 attempt exactly one UpdateAsync final save. Reproduce stored coins=200 with owned session, player earns 300, mock UpdateAsync throws once at leave and would succeed next call. The server warns but never retries, leaves persisted coins=200 and sessionOwner lease held for up to 180 seconds; next join times out after ~2s. Require bounded retry/backoff for transient save errors, retain owner/revision fencing and avoid duplicate mutation, add canonical-server injected-once-failure regression and explicit failure observability. No claim of crash-proof durability.

findings.reproduction: GetAsync raises for stored 500; loadProgress returns nil,false; join starts default active state with persistAllowed=false. Progress earned is never saved.
findings.expected: Explicit load failure must prevent normal gameplay and show rejoin/retry; no saved record overwritten. Regression must catch current head.

findings.reproduction: After claiming stored 200, earn 300; final UpdateAsync raises transiently once on leave; no retry, stored remains 200 and lease persists.
findings.expected: Bounded retry for transient final save, maintain exact-session ownership, test injected-once-failure and unsuccessful terminal outcome.

limitations: Exact-head offline CI PASS does not test these two failure paths as fail-closed/recoverable; rejoin fixture currently accepts unsafe read fallback.
No live Roblox DataStore, Studio, two-server, or mobile verification.
